item.name: Allegro
item.summary: Read and update Allegro offers, stock and prices, orders, returns, shipments and messages.
item.description:
Connect workflows to Allegro, the Polish online marketplace, through the Allegro REST API. Everyday steps read all your offers, update stock and prices of many offers at once and read the outcome, and read orders and order events.

Every one of the 270 documented operations of the Allegro REST API has its own step: offers and batch changes, products and categories, pricing and promotion, orders, returns, disputes and messages, shipping and delivery, account and fulfillment. Amounts are exact decimals. A connection is one Allegro or Allegro Sandbox account, authorized through your own Allegro application.
item.setup_summary: Register an application at apps.developer.allegro.pl, add its Client ID and Client Secret to the connection, sign in to Allegro and run the connection test.
